purpose: The action row: every row of buttons in an app (dialog buttons, a confirmation's Cancel and Delete, a record's Delete, a Delete confirm).
namedChanges: 0.1.3: the purpose, the library title and the library note no longer give form Save/Cancel or a record's Edit as examples: a record's fields save as the person types (RuleUiSaveAsYouType). The README's record-view example is now a Delete-only row (`destructive` alone), and its wrong readings no longer show Edit or Save beside Delete. Words only; no code changed.
The header comment is reworded; no code change.
Added after the copy (0.1.1): the optional primary, cancel and destructive slots, the narrow-width rule and the dev warning; the children API is unchanged.

0.1.2: the structured row carries the class `gs-actionrow` and marks the destructive slot `gs-actionrow__far`, writes the shared action-row CSS once (`src/actionRowCss.ts`, a copy of style-runtime's, kept identical by a test) so the equal-share narrow rule works without Tailwind, and takes `confirm` (no far slot, Cancel then a red primary, Cancel the default). The children API row also gains `gs-actionrow` and the CSS (its pinned class-string test now expects it first); every Tailwind class is kept, so Tailwind hosts see no change.

library.title: Button row (Mac order): dialog buttons, confirmations, form actions
library.note: Use for every row of buttons: dialog, form actions, a record's Delete, 'Delete X?' confirm. Positive rightmost, Cancel left of it, Delete alone at far left. Comes with the app style (style-runtime). For one button look take button; for the remove control take remove-control.
